Scenario Event: Employees report ransom notes and inaccessible shared files
Expected Actions: Validate alerts; open incident; preserve initial evidence; escalate
Evaluation Criteria: Incident criteria and escalation path are clear

Scenario Event: A dormant administrator account shows suspicious authentication activity
Expected Actions: Disable compromised access; rotate credentials; scope activity; preserve logs
Evaluation Criteria: Containment balances security and operational needs

Scenario Event: Customer-support platform becomes unavailable and customer calls increase
Expected Actions: Declare business impact; prioritize services; activate workaround; brief leadership
Evaluation Criteria: Recovery priorities and communications are defined

Scenario Event: Threat actor shares a sample of customer data and threatens publication
Expected Actions: Validate sample; assess breach; notify counsel and insurer; begin notification analysis
Evaluation Criteria: Regulatory and contractual decisions have owners

Expected Actions: Apply payment decision framework; evaluate sanctions; contact insurer and law enforcement
Evaluation Criteria: Payment authority and criteria are documented

Scenario Event: Backups are intact but support-platform restoration has not been tested recently
Expected Actions: Validate clean backups; establish recovery environment; test restoration; monitor reinfection
Evaluation Criteria: Recovery evidence and acceptance authority are clear

Scenario Event: A reporter asks whether customer data was stolen
Expected Actions: Use holding statement; coordinate facts; preserve confidentiality; set update cadence

Scenario Event: Core systems are restored and monitoring shows no new encryption
Expected Actions: Validate services; reset credentials; increase monitoring; plan lessons learned
Evaluation Criteria: Closure criteria and post-incident actions are defined
